Ariane de Rothschild (born Ariane Langner, 1965) is a French-born businesswoman who became Chairwoman of the Edmond de Rothschild Group following the death of her husband Benjamin de Rothschild in January 2021. As CEO of Edmond de Rothschild during 2013-2019, she maintained an extensive personal and financial relationship with Jeffrey Epstein, documented across dozens of EFTA emails, schedule entries, and House Oversight records. The relationship centered on a $25 million consulting agreement executed in October 2015 through Epstein's Southern Trust Company in the U.S. Virgin Islands, nominally for advisory services related to the bank's escalating 1MDB exposure. The agreement was negotiated in July-August 2015 with Epstein explicitly tying its completion to an upcoming DOJ meeting set for August 27: "I would like to get an agreement, though I know the logistics are complex, before the DOJ meeting" (EFTA02718592).

Ariane's communications with Epstein reveal her as an active, confiding counterpart who shared privileged regulatory intelligence in real time. On June 24, 2016, she told Epstein she was "preparing meeting for next week at CSSF about 1MDB" — the Luxembourg financial regulator overseeing EdR. Five days later, when ninety Luxembourg police officers raided the bank, she messaged Epstein: "Shit is hitting the fan. Police throughout the bank — full bk search with people locked and not allowed to get out" (EFTA02459022). Epstein immediately forwarded this to Kathryn Ruemmler — former White House Counsel turned Latham & Watkins partner — with the single word "go" (EFTA02459040), activating a crisis-management operation in which Ruemmler served as de facto general counsel to EdR for the 1MDB emergency. Ariane later confirmed: "I have 3 of the top Lux law firms working for us + Yves + Kathy on all angles" (EFTA02455931).

The relationship extended well beyond crisis advisory. Epstein acted as a strategic counselor on EdR governance, advising Ariane to use Brexit as cover for management purges — to which she responded: "Brexit will give me the excuse to downsize & clean deeper. Get rid of those people who have kept bad values" (EFTA02459917). He recruited senior executives for the bank, including a former CFO of Deutsche Bank and BMW. He advised on the intra-Rothschild family naming dispute with Jacob Rothschild. He brokered introductions between EdR executives and his Gulf contacts, connecting Olivier Colom to Sultan Bin Sulayem. And on a personal level, Epstein ordered gifts for Ariane's daughter, sent presents to her niece Alice at NYU, toured the 854 Fifth Avenue property with Ariane and Karyna Shuliak, and received intimate confidences about her marital tensions with Benjamin. A May 2015 email subject line — "ruemmler, leon, mort, rosvky, ariane ??!!" (EFTA02718629) — places her alongside Leon Black, Mortimer Zuckerman, and Ruemmler in Epstein's top-tier inner circle. The same Southern Trust Company that received the $25 million from EdR was simultaneously used to fund Reporty/Carbyne, Ehud Barak's Israeli cyberweapons startup — creating a single USVI financial pipeline linking a European bank's regulatory crisis to intelligence-grade surveillance technology.

Within weeks, Colom was writing to Epstein with conspicuous familiarity: "We had fun with Ariane this week. She talked everyday about you and the advice you gave her last Sunday. And her mum likes you as well" (October 18, 2013, HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_031106).

Have already seen some models come and go — to your liking I think." This interweaving of bank business with Epstein's personal procurement pattern is consistent across the correspondence.

Epstein leveraged the Colom channel to connect EdR to his Gulf network. On October 14, 2013, he sent a terse introduction email to Colom's EdR address (o.colom@edr.com): "sultan — olivier. oliver sultan" (EFTA02520001). This one-line email connected a Dubai state-adjacent logistics magnate to the Rothschild banking operation through Epstein's personal brokerage. Honestly don't know if it's at your friend's level... does he have an assistant or an associate, it would be more appropriate. Otherwise, want to see my friend member of European Parliament?" Colom departed EdR in June 2016 — his auto-reply reading "a quitte Le Groupe Edmond de Rothschild" — just days before the police raid on the Luxembourg branch.
